name: Synechocystis PCC6803 photoAUTOTROPH (autotrophic biomass, CO2-fixing) [derived from iJN678]
notes: A REAL photoautotroph (3rd organism): oxygenic photosynthesis -- fixes CO2 using LIGHT and evolves O2. Verified photoautotrophic (light+CO2, no organics -> growth 0.167, O2 produced). Popped out two things: (1) LIGHT as an FBA input is a NON-CHEMICAL species (BiGG formula 'Z' = radiant energy) -> maps to a chemical:false 'light' port, reconciling with the phenomenological phototroph. (2) dFBA MEDIUM CONTROL: this genome-scale model leaves glucose default-open, so it could grow on PHANTOM carbon; glucose is therefore MAPPED as an input (gated by the medium) so it can only use carbon the microcosm medium provides. Trace minerals (K, SO4, Fe, Mg, ...) stay unmapped/freely-available (realistic, not carbon cheats). Oxygenic -> declares an OXIDIZING redox window, so it correctly cannot share a well-mixed medium with the strict-anaerobe methanogen (O2 poisons methanogens). AUTOTROPHIC VARIANT: objective set to BIOMASS_Ec_SynAuto and glucose uptake closed so it fixes CO2 with light, for the greenhouse-gas-capture scenario.

validity.note: dynamic FBA; oxygenic photoautotroph. Photon uptake needs a high vmax (photons are cheap, plentiful).
